title: Convert Date to Binary
summary: Given a date string in yyyy-mm-dd format, convert each component (year, month, day) to binary without leading zeroes, then concatenate them in year-month-day order.
statement: Given a date string in yyyy-mm-dd format, convert each component (year, month, day) to binary without leading zeroes, then concatenate them in year-month-day order.
constraints: Convert year, month, and day independently to binary without leading zeros.
Join the three binary components with hyphens.
reference_solution:
def date_components_to_binary(date):
    return '-'.join(bin(int(part))[2:] for part in date.split('-'))
hints: Split the fixed-format date on hyphens.
Parse each component as an integer to discard decimal leading zeros.
Use binary conversion without its 0b prefix and rejoin with hyphens.
Each field is transformed independently and remains in the required year-month-day order.
editorial: Each field is transformed independently and remains in the required year-month-day order.

tests.explanation: The month and day each become binary one.
